en: The image depicts a sepia-toned photograph mounted on a dark blue or gray postcard frame. The photograph shows a very large group of men, possibly students or members of an organization, posed in front of a two-story building with several open windows. The men are dressed in early 20th-century European clothing. There is Cyrillic text above and below the photo, some of which is in purple ink and aligns with the period's style.
